explanation.intuition: Group integers according to whether they can be made entirely of pairs.
explanation.manipulation: Supply an integer witness for an odd value: n = 2k + 1.
explanation.pattern: Every integer belongs to the even or odd class under ordinary integer arithmetic.
explanation.mechanism: The representation n = 2k or n = 2k + 1 makes a classification checkable and can choose a branch of an update rule.

vocabulary.meaning: An integer of the form 2k for integer k.
An integer of the form 2k + 1 for integer k.

notation.meaning: An integer witness k exhibits oddness.

formal.text: For n in Z: n is even iff there exists k in Z with n=2k. n is odd iff there exists k in Z with n=2k+1.

proof.label: worked-example
proof.limitation: This exhibits oddness for one integer; it is not a general result about Collatz orbits.

explanation.frontier: What happens when parity decides which update rule to apply?
